HG18-refix2:
Come all the way back

Make sure that you come out of the session in reverse to how you got in. If you floated up, float back down the same way and come back down to your chosen weight. If you shrank yourself, make sure that you come back to your normal size. If you went inside to a younger you or parts of you make sure that you know that you are whole now, in your body and with your adult judgement. If you traveled somewhere, come back the same way. Only bring back what you need to bring back.

You may want to say something like, "I am only bringing back what I need to bring back at this time. Anything that is not needed by me at this time I will store away safely until such time as I need it. I am coming back now to this place, to my body and to normal day to day living, to doing one honest action at a time. Any instructions that I gave myself to go deeper or to remain in session are now over. (Unless you are giving yourself instructions to implement in ordinary life or to cue practice at a future time, and those instructions should not take you out of ordinary life.) I am me now, in my body, with my adult judgement."

Then you might want to count yourself out. "1 I am coming back now into my body, to my chosen weight. 2 I am coming back to my normal breathing pattern. 3 I am hearing the sounds around me now, I am in (where ever you are). 4 I am moving my fingers and my toes, my shoulders and my eyes. 5 I am opening my eyes now, feeling normal and present. My session is over."

When you come out make sure that you come all the way out. State to yourself what day it is or what date it is. Look to your left and to your right. Look at something close and something far away. Move about a little bit before you stand up, and only stand up when you feel that you can do so. Make sure that you are alert and oriented. Just because you counted, doesn't mean that you are all the way out. Take note of what you need to do as a result of the session, if anything, and then go about doing something normal.

What if it’s a recording and it stops and you’re stuck? Say to yourself, “the recording has stopped, and the session is over” and then use the above method to force yourself out. Just opening your eyes and saying where you are, what day it is, pushing down with your feet or hands and moving about, looking around and then use the 5 step method. Don’t just sit there waiting for the voice to come back and release you.

NOTE: If you’re using a recording to go to sleep with, then it’s all right to have the recording put you to sleep or have you in a quiet resting state. However, if it’s for waking practice, it shouldn’t leave you in a role, with lowered judgement, with impaired movement capabilities, blank, with an undefined reset word, invited to stay altered indefinitely, etc.
HG23-refix2:
Capacity before content

NOTE: If it is medically unsafe or you are in a place of panic, sleep deprivation, nausea, deep destabilization, mania, psychosis like symptoms, feeling overwhelmed by chemicals etc. then first focus on stabilizing and then look for what your subconscious needs you to know! If it takes you destabilizing to know what your subconscious knows, it is not meant for you to know directly at this time! Focus on asking for capacity over content!

Sometimes, your subconscious knows something that your conscious self is not prepared to know. It may be something related to your sexuality, grief, trauma, family issues, betrayal, shame, vocation, a relationship, illness fears, spirituality, addiction, identity, moral issues etc.

What you DON’T want to do is bully your subconscious into telling you what it knows by saying things to yourself like:

“What is it you won’t tell me? What are you hiding? Tell me NOW! I am telling you to tell me!”

This often leads to flooding, panic, false certainty, confabulation, dissociation etc. and can make your day SUCK! When you are flooded, you cannot access your adult capacities so focus on being able to regulate and getting support! Sometimes, it is better not to know what is not being said until your adult has the capacities to regulate, get support, be humble, etc. Just ask for what you need to know in a way that you CAN tolerate:

“What do I need to know that will help me get the capacity to know the thing you know that I need to know?” “What can you tell me, that will make my conscious self 5% better at knowing the thing you want to tell me?” “Can you tell me in symbolic form so I am not completely overwhelmed by the revelation?” “Can you tell me what I need to do to be safe, without actually telling me what it is”? “Do I need to know WHAT it is, or do I need to know that I need to get some support to have the capacity to know what it is, and who would be a good person to help me?” etc.

Instead, say to yourself something like this:

“Dear Wise Subconscious Mind, if there is something you know that my conscious self is not ready to know, please don’t break it open violently! Do what you can to make me able to know it in a way that is safe! Prepare me BEFORE you break it open! Ground me BEFORE you show me the memory! Support me BEFORE you make it intense!” etc.

REMEMBER: Not everything in hypnotic imagery is literal, especially if it relates to trauma and memory. The mind makes it symbolic, squashes things together, distorts, dramatizes, pulls from cultural influences, fears etc. So, treat it like an image and get some help outside of yourself!
HG36-refix2:
Appendix G: Altered states

NB: I am NOT saying use these. However, many people attempt to do things for the first time such as self hypnosis, contact with their inner child, contact with their Higher Self etc when they are in a mind altered state.

If you do use them, be aware you don't want to force a revelation out of the state but instead use it to help you do things in your regular life.

If you have had an opening in the past, the key is to recognize that it is different to have an experience, access it in a particular state and access it in your day to day life. It is great that it has opened but if the child can't take it in, then

Use phrases such as; Help me to ground. Help me to only take that which I can take in. Help me to remember love. Help me to come back when the time is right. Help me to take one change into my regular life.

You should NOT use self hypnosis to; Keep you in that state forever Get memories to come up Make yourself afraid to do things Not sleep Override things that your body needs Not talk to people

If you are doing this in an altered state of consciousness and it is helping you not to love, not to ground, not to be honest, not to sleep, not to communicate, not to do regular life things, you need to STOP trying to go deeper and work on integrating what you have.

Stabilize before you interpret

Self hypnosis is powerful. Especially when you are in an altered state of consciousness, either through loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grief, sexual energy, prayer, not sleeping, or any other number of ways similar to plant medicines, often your mind opens faster then your adult can figure out what is going on.
HG24-refix:
Troubleshooting

Nothing happens

Could you try this a bit smaller?

Show me one body sensation, one word, whether to listen or rest today.

It feels fake

What in particular feels fake? If it's that you aren't getting an inner voice/image, it isn't necessarily a resistance or not being an adult. If it's telling you to do something you don't want to do, it's okay to correct it. If it turns out to be a protection, you can talk to it.

“What are you protecting me from?” or “Are you afraid I will lie to myself again?” or “Are you afraid this will just be a performance?”

It could be an inner voice of a parent you are picking up that is enforcing a rule about how you should be to belong, if so don’t argue with it, find out what rule it is enforcing and then work on finding ordinary evidence that would make your new adult voice more believable.

It may be that you’re trying to access an adult part that isn’t there yet. If that’s the case, then stop trying to talk to an inner voice that you aren’t able to believe yet. If you have enough observing ego, borrow some from a real or imagined caring person. Try out some statements or actions etc. that you can believe, even if it’s just one sentence, and see how it goes.

The subconscious will not answer

There may not be an answer. There may not be an answer that will help you. You may need to try asking a different question or you may just need to rest or finish your inner work for the day. If you think it will be helpful, you can try asking your subconscious “What would you need to know in order to trust me?” Some examples of answers might be “I need to know you will set boundaries” “I need to know you will do what you said you will do” “I need to know you won’t keep leaving” “I need to know you won’t think that knowing something means that you don’t need to do anything about it” etc.

The inner child will not appear

If you can figure out who the guard is, talk to it. If you can’t, just work with what you are aware of. You can say to the guard “You don’t have to let me in, just tell me what I need to do to make it safe”. Even if there isn’t a child part that you can talk to, you can work with whatever you are aware of. You can work on your preferences or something that you’re curious about or something that you’re willing to try as a beginner etc. and see how it goes. Work on developing a sense of who you are and reparent yourself as best you can.

You get anxious

Find out if the anxiety is bad enough that you want to decrease contact with it or if you can manage it and let it continue. If the anxiety is getting too bad, then you need to help your body, like the following:

-Where are your feet? Where are you sitting? Focus on your body and your breathing.

-Tell your Little parts and Protector parts that you’re there for your Little parts and that you recognize that your Protector parts are trying to protect you and that you don’t need them to scream at you in order for you to know that something is wrong. Ask them if they need you to do something and if they do, ask them to show you one step at a time that you can do. If they don’t, then ask them to let your body calm down.

If you’re having chest pain, fainting, suicidal thoughts, psychosis-like symptoms, mania-like symptoms, severe dissociative symptoms, not being able to sleep, wanting to hurt yourself or somebody else, etc. then you need to get help. For more on handling anxiety, see the toolbox in Appendix D.

You dissociate or feel unreal

Open your eyes, move around, feel something, name 5 things that you can see, and end your work for the day.

You become grandiose

Go eat, go to sleep, do some chores, accept some humility, find somebody to disagree with you, etc.

What do you say to yourself in that moment? “If it’s really there, it’ll still be here after a good night’s sleep, some food, some time, etc, and some subsequent humility, feedback, etc, etc.”

You become too analytical

You’re being too analytical. “What if you didn’t try?” Put your hand on your heart, your other on your solar plexis, and say, “I don’t have to do this. I’m here for a relationship with something deeper than my surface mind.” “What can you do to make this a communion, not a performance?” Then do something. Usually it’s silence, resting, or doing something. Whatever it is, just do it.

You become too blissful or diffuse

You’re being too blissful, diffuse, etc. Bring it down to a more specific level. “What’s the smallest, most specific thing you can do to demonstrate the love you’re feeling?”

You want the hidden truth immediately

You’re wanting to know something you’re not supposed to know yet. Refrain from doing anything, and say, “Show me more capacity first, and if what I want to know is really for me, you’ll show me later on.”

You keep daydreaming

You’re daydreaming. Sit up and open your eyes, and ask yourself, “What are you avoiding doing in the real world by doing this?”

You get stuck in spiritual bypass

You’re doing spiritual bypass. Ask yourself, “Where has divine love not come down and hugged your hurt yet?”

You’ve had some amazing opening that showed you how much more love and freedom is possible, but your kid isn’t receiving it. Or maybe prayer has led you to feel abandoned or condemned by God. Or maybe a teacher betrayed you. Whatever the problem, it’s not going to get resolved by doing more of the same.

Sometimes you just need to do something practical to take care of yourself until the horizon of your life expands enough for what you’re seeking to enter. Or you need to follow your curiosity for what will make you happy, regardless of whether it makes sense or not. Or you need to realize you already have plenty of love and meaning in your life, and this whole spirituality thing is optional.

You get stuck in endless processing

You’re processing the same stuff over and over again. First ask yourself, “Do I really have something I need to deal with, or am I just doing a check?” It’s okay to go over the same stuff over and over again (especially when you’re grieving or doing a practice), but sometimes you’re just doing a check.

If you determine you’re doing a check, say to yourself, “It’s okay for that thought to be there, but I don’t need to hold a meeting with it right now. I’m going to do ____ instead.”

Ask yourself, “What would your Leader do in this situation?”

You keep using hypnosis but not changing life

You’re doing hypnosis over and over again without making changes in your life. Ask yourself, “What can I do to show my kid I’m for real?” Then go do it.
HG29+30-refix:
Appendices

Note: You can skip this section and just use the main path and be fine. This is additional info to help you be more precise and safe, and some additional scripts for other situations.

Appendix A: How to ask the subconscious a useful question

Your subconscious mind is NOT a large language model of AI. However, there is a bit of overlap in the way you can ask questions to both. So, if you know how to do prompt engineering for AI, this can be very useful to use it to help you be more present, honest, loving etc. On the other hand, if you use it to be more controlling, it will NOT work.

To get as much precision as possible, you need to include the following in your prompt:

Role: Who or what are you talking to?

Context: Give some context so it knows what you’re talking about.

Intention: What do you want to change or accomplish?

Constraint: What do you need to do to make sure your asking is safe, true, kind etc.

Output: How do you want to receive the answer? As an image, phrase, sensation in your body, memory, action, question, symbol, silence, rest etc.

Evaluation: How are you going to evaluate the answer? How will you know if it’s true, kind, timely, stabilizing, specific, testable etc?

Iteration: Iterate by changing your prompt depending on what you get from reality as feedback.

Most importantly, you always need to make your prompt “safe” otherwise, the analytical part of your mind will “make up” an answer just so it fits with your prompt. I usually add the following to my prompt:

“If you need more time or the best and safest answer is silence, then I ask you to make my body go into a deeper state of comfortable rest. A peaceful silence would be a successful answer to my question.”

There is a very good chance there is no answer for your question because there is nothing happening. It might be that it’s not time yet, or that you need to go rest or do whatever you need to do.

Once you do that, here are the core prompts you can use:

Core prompts

For getting clarity: “I ask you, my wise subconscious mind, to show me what is true, kind and timely. If what you want to show me is too intense for me to integrate, please transfer it to my conscious mind in a way I can integrate it, for instance as a symbol, a signal in my body, a next step I can take. Most importantly, show me first my capacity to be peaceful, and then, the content of my wounding.”

When you experience resistance: “What are you protecting me from? How can you trust me 1% more?”

When you want to ask your inner child something: “What do you want me to know? What do you need me to do today so that you are not alone in dealing with it?”

When you want to ask one of your protectors something: “What do you need me to do in the external world so that you can feel that you and the system are safe?”

When you want to ask your leader or guru self: “What direction is the most in alignment with truth, love, life and all beings?”

When you want to listen to your intuition: “I ask my intuition to give me a signal, my analytical mind to decipher it, my body to give me feedback as to whether my deciphering is correct and reality to give me feedback as to whether my deciphering is correct.”

When you want to know if a particular intuition you have is coming from your universal heart or from your programming (this one is longer and more complicated): “I ask my wise subconscious mind to help me see if the intuition or impulse I have about …is coming from my universal heart or from my family, my religion, marketing, erotic programming, my political tribe, my trauma response or an old deal I did as a child to belong. If it’s coming from my programming, I ask the parts responsible for it to step back and soften so that I can have true guidance from my universal heart that will help me make my life better in the most simple ways possible. Let my body give me feedback as to the difference.”

When you are daydreaming: “If this daydream has useful guidance for me, I ask my wise subconscious mind to show it to me. If this is my way of not dealing with my life, I ask my wise subconscious mind to help me come back to the present and deal with my life.”

When you are anxious: “What are you protecting me from? How can you trust more my adult self?”

When you suspect there is something true that you don’t know: “If knowing the truth is too much for me, please don’t show me everything. Show me first my capacity to be peaceful, and then, the content of my wounding.”

Once you get an answer, you can ask: “What can I do in my ordinary life to integrate what I have heard?”

The prompt will tell your subconscious what you want. The NLP will make sure you are getting it in a safe way.
HG04-refix:
Quick start: do this first

To work on difficulties or cultivate positive qualities (love, curiosity, play, confidence, etc.), simply gather attention and do these steps, in order: 1) Attention; 2) Notice; 3) Respond; 4) Wait; 5) Come all the way back . Not much needs to happen in each session!

It may be helpful, prior to your first session, to read through the induction and the full return in waking life, so you’re more familiar with it. Give yourself a chunk of time when you can be physically secure for the time it takes. Prior to each session, consider what one thing you’re going to be working on or cultivating during this session, and what you’re going to leave alone. Put this screen on the shelf and conduct the practice.

You'll follow whatever you notice - sensation, image, phrase, feeling, objection, silence - as you're invited. Vary the invites as needed to be responsive & warm, to create a boundary, to give direction or more time, etc. Complete the return. After, note what happened & any real-world actions.

If at any point you feel panicky, disoriented, more unreal, or less functional, this is not about bravely sticking with difficult feelings (that's another choice, made freely & while staying present). Stop deepening, return to the room & get appropriate support.

Do you usually think in words?

Before choosing a script, notice: do you talk to yourself in your head -- silent words & phrases -- a lot, some, little, never? Does it vary when you plan, remember, reflect, or feel upset? If it doesn't come naturally, can you make yourself think in words, silently? (Thinking in words doesn't mean you hear them.)

This doesn't mean that in any given moment you may not notice feelings before words. You don’t have to decide that feelings always come first. This isn't a diagnosis, just a way of finding what's useful. "Not sure" is an answer.

If you don't normally think in words, you may want to say things aloud, in writing, on a recording, etc., when this guide says "say." Or, just do what it invites, without preparing what you're going to say. When it says "ask" the child or protector, or "listen" for a response, it doesn't mean they'll be saying full sentences to you. It also doesn't mean you'll get pictures in your head instead. Just do whatever you can, and try different ways as needed.

HG06-refix:
Protecting Yourself from Hypnotists

Hypnotism can happen in a therapist’s office, but it can also happen through music, marketing, religious rituals, sexual chemistry, charismatic authority, social media, grief, fear, political messaging, sense of belonging, fatigue, love, trauma, beauty, etc.

Even when not actively engaging the conscious mind, there are many ways to influence people. Marketers and interface designers know this perfectly well. In the Federal Trade Commission’s report on “dark patterns,” they describe designs that trick or manipulate consumers. The Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) describes commercial patterns that steer, deceive, coerce, or manipulate people toward choices that may work against their interests.

Is a conscious agreement the same as being unconsciously receptive, emotionally compliant or legally and ethically consenting? What if someone influences a persons mind other then when they are a legal adult?

From the school of Silva Mind Control:

“If you don’t learn to control your mind, someone else will!”

You are surrounded by many forces who are already using these techniques to train your mind. Wouldn’t it be great if you could turn the tables around and use them yourself? When you learn to use these techniques on yourself, you are using self-hypnosis techniques to befriend your deeper mind, listen to it, and empower yourself to make more of your own choices as an adult.
